title: feat(rho16): on B16, rho still fails reverse and stays much rounder than nu
science: Host-size robustness repeat of #6765 on B_16(0) (6017 sites): the roundness/reversal decoupling holds -- var_rho=0.00096369 vs var_nu=0.00678027, rho seven times rounder yet still failing the diamond (1728 < 3136), and the exact axis identity t_rho = 3|v|_2 is restated (t_rho(16,0,0)=48).
